stem: A particle experiences constant acceleration for 20 s after starting from rest, travelling s₁ in the first 10 s and s₂ in the next 10 s: (a) s₂ = s₁ (b) s₂ = 2s₁ (c) s₂ = 3s₁ (d) s₂ = 4s₁
A car accelerates at rate f through distance S, continues at constant speed for time t, decelerates at f/2 to rest. Total distance 15S; find S
Air friction causes vertical retardation equal to 10% of g (g = 10 ms⁻²). The maximum height will be decreased by: (a) 8% (b) 9% (c) 10% (d) 11%
A car starts from rest and moves with constant acceleration. Ratio of the distance covered in the nth second to that covered in n seconds: (a) 2/n² − 1/n (b) 2/n² + 1/n (c) 2/n − 1/n² (d) 2/n + 1/n²
